messages.subject: RStan 2.0.0 install instructions
parts:
The install instructions have changed for v2.0.0.


The getting started guide has updated install instructions:
https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/wiki/RStan-Getting-Started



If you're ever in doubt, our home page will have the latest links:
http://mc-stan.org


Daniel


PS. We have consolidated our project pages to GitHub. The Google Code page no longer exists.
